purpose: Downplay an event as not serious enough to justify a reaction.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
V dictionary + ほどのことではない
You are only a little late; it is not worth apologizing over.
This scratch is not serious enough to worry about.
We merely met by chance; it is nothing to be surprised about.
formation: V dictionary + ほどのことではない
restrictions: Often reassures someone about apology, surprise, or worry.
mistake: The verb names an excessive reaction, not the event itself.
